review_checks.check: 1. Requirement binding, genre, association-specific use, title-blind identification
review_checks.rationale: Exact official text reproduced verbatim (官方原文照錄) and bound to PDF page 1; no checkbox serial asserted; document operates as an institutional SOP (制度文件) matching the Blueprint genre 專屬佐證紀錄｜…_制度文件; §1 Table 1 解讀界線 correctly limits conclusions to what the source supports.

review_checks.check: 2. Complete operational policy chain: policy → learners/needs/competencies → positioning → design review → update/exceptions/HOLD
review_checks.locator: §2 (policy handling, 权威來源順序, conflict HOLD); §3 (categories/targeting/positioning statement); §4 (needs sourcing + competency chain Table 5); §5 (matrix + decision fields); §6 (roles, process Table 7, review Table 8, cadence Table 9, monitoring Table 10, deviation Table 11); §11 (reject/HOLD master list)
review_checks.rationale: Every stage has named actors, inputs, control points, outputs, and branches (PASS/REVISE/HOLD/REJECT with closure conditions); tables are actionable with filling rules and worked values, not template-only.

review_checks.locator: TABLES 21–25 (Forms A–E); §6.1 Table 6 (roles/outputs); §6.6 Table 11 (grading/closure); §12.1 (attachment index); §10 Fact-ID register with per-item replacement originals and review responsibility
review_checks.rationale: Each form field has rules, sample value, evidence location; roles are functional codes explicitly marked synthetic; rejection/return/HOLD triggers enumerated in §6.3 and §11; attachment index states no external files and locates internal content. Minor structural and citation-neatness notes recorded under findings (non-blocking).

review_checks.check: 4. Mathematical consistency of all showcased scores/ratios; design suggestion vs official TTQS rule
review_checks.locator: §4.2 (signal-rate formula), §5.1 (weights, anchors, standardization), §7.2 Tables 13–15, §7.3 Table 17, §7.4 Table 18, §8 Tables 22–23, §6.5 Table 10
review_checks.rationale: All numbers recompute: 9/12=75.0%, 8/12=66.7%, 7/12=58.3%; weights 25+25+20+15+15=100; A 340÷5=68.0, B 430÷5=86.0, C 380÷5=76.0; 20+45+60+45+50+20=240 min; 0–2×4 items max 8 with threshold 6 internally consistent. All thresholds/weights/cadences are explicitly labeled as management suggestions, not official TTQS rules (§1 Table 1 解讀界線, §5.1 preamble, §6.4).

review_checks.check: 5. SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC boundary; no fabricated approval, real course, survey, signature, or performance
review_checks.locator: Front page status block; §7.1; §8 preamble; §10 Tables 27 (F001–F083) + §10.2/§10.3; Table 19/24 per-row HOLD/PASS qualification; Table 20/25 (OPEN/HOLD, no closure)
review_checks.rationale: Every synthetic date (2026-10-20/21, 2026-11-04), role code (R-S01/R-S02), number, score, decision, and result carries a Fact ID with locator and required real replacement evidence; no third-party originals, signatures, or organizational performance claimed; negative claims (未招生、未發布、無學員) are consistently maintained; replacement register is granular enough to substitute real facts without ambiguity.

review_checks.check: 6. Cross-section consistency, fact IDs, internal references, adjacency to I02-E01/0010 and I02-E03/0012
review_checks.locator: §1.1 (boundary with 0010/0012/course list); §9 Table 26 (traceability incl. I02-E04 boundary); Fig-ID reuse rule §10.1; internal section/table references in Tables 21–26 verified against their targets
review_checks.rationale: The document explicitly refuses to absorb 0010's assessment-standard facts and 0012's discount/subsidy facts; cross-references resolve to the claimed sections/tables; matrix scores and demand percentages recur identically across §7 and §8 with consistent Fact IDs.

review_checks.check: 7. Human readability and direct usability for association staff and evaluators
review_checks.locator: Front page 30-second usage block; §8 five-step operating order; §1 throughout
review_checks.rationale: Purpose, reader, timing, operation, output, and SAMPLE status are stated up front in plain language; no evaluator-engineering internal jargon on the front page; executional forms are self-contained.

review_checks.check: 8. Front-page version label agrees with R11; no formal/REAL status claimed
review_checks.locator: Front page: 文件代碼 0011／I02-E02; 版本 R11; 草案撰寫日 2026-10-29; 文件狀態 SAMPLE／SYNTHETIC
review_checks.rationale: Version label reads R11 consistent with this review's subject; document explicitly disclaims approval, effectiveness, publication, and any REAL status.

nonblocking_low_advisories.locator: §8 TABLE 21 (Form A) vs Blueprint required table 欄位—定義—來源—填寫者—驗證規則
nonblocking_low_advisories.concrete_defect: No single table carries the verbatim five-column field-dictionary structure (定義 and 填寫者 are not distinct columns). The required content is substantively distributed: filling rules ≙ validation, values with evidence locations ≙ source, and filler/verifier roles appear in values (R-S01/R-S02) and in §6.1 Table 6 / §10.3.
nonblocking_low_advisories.required_minimal_repair: Non-blocking. Optional cosmetic alignment: add explicit 定義 and 填寫者 columns to Form A or a one-line note identifying which existing columns carry each of the five roles.

nonblocking_low_advisories.concrete_defect: Two Fact-ID citations point to adjacent rather than exact facts: [F056] (objective learning goals) and [F057] (unit-method-goal consistency) are cited to support 'no pass-rate generated / five-column completeness check' notes, where F058 or the register's own note would be the nearer identifier.
nonblocking_low_advisories.required_minimal_repair: Non-blocking. Retarget the two citations (or rely on F081/F080 as appropriate) in a future revision; no value or rule changes required.

nonblocking_low_advisories.concrete_defect: Table 7-5 row 1 names three behavioral anchors (hazard, prioritization, escalation) while the §7.4 rubric defines four scored behaviors (adding service-boundary holding); the reconciliation (the four behaviors span the whole integrated practice, not a single row) is inferable but not stated.
nonblocking_low_advisories.required_minimal_repair: Non-blocking. Add one clarifying clause that the four-item rubric applies to the integrated exercise across rows.

nonblocking_low_advisories.concrete_defect: The placement of the official text under the parent item 「對外明確的訓練政策」 is asserted as source detail, while this packet's binding establishes only the exact text and page 1; the parent-item attribution is not verified within the provided evidence.
nonblocking_low_advisories.required_minimal_repair: Non-blocking. Hedge to 'official table context as recorded in the runtime SOURCE map' or verify against the hash-bound source page before any external use; the exact-text quote and page binding themselves are intact.
